name: Lightwave Logic, Inc.
blurb: Lightwave Logic develops and licenses electro-optic (EO) polymer materials — branded Perkinamine — that convert electrical signals into light with greater efficiency and bandwidth than conventional lithium niobate or silicon photonics modulators. EO polymers can operate at higher speeds and lower drive voltages, enabling smaller, lower-power optical modulators for 200G and 400G per-lane data-centre and AI networking applications. The company does not manufacture transceivers; it licenses its material technology to foundries and systems integrators.
recent: In April 2026, Lightwave Logic's polymers were embedded into GlobalFoundries' silicon-photonics platform via the GDSFactory design kit, targeting 200G/400G per lane data-centre AI applications — a significant commercialisation milestone. Shares gained approximately 344% in 2026 and reached a four-year high. A Motley Fool report noted insider selling of 20,000 shares in April 2026 following the run-up. The company ended 2025 with $69M cash, minimal revenue ($236,855 in FY2025), and an operating loss of approximately $20M — it remains pre-commercial revenue stage, funding operations from its cash balance.
